summary: Qzone RPC answers HTTP 200 but rejects every request with retcode 4001 'not authorized', including requests with no credentials at all
reasoning: The empty-cookie control is what settles it. Removing credentials entirely produces the same retcode as presenting a valid p_skey, so the endpoint is not evaluating the cookie at all -- it refuses before authentication. g_tk was ruled out separately: three different accumulation strategies produced an identical value.
not_attempted: Implementing the 17 request builders from NapCat's route table -- the transport is refused before any body is read, so they would be unverifiable dead code
how_to_recheck: Re-run tools/probe_qzone_auth.py. If 'empty cookie' and 'p_skey' start differing, authentication is being evaluated and the route table becomes worth implementing.
